# Open questions — bpg-rs

What is not yet known, and what has since been answered.

## Open

### Can DM capture/replay be extended beyond the existing partial reuse path?

`open` · `@bpg.question.chroma-dm-capture-replay/1`

The existing chroma_reuse_dm path only skips DM rebuild when DM
wins under rough pruning. Item 1 of the optimization-testing-plan
asks whether capturing the materialized DM chroma result for wider
cost/rebuild reuse is worth doing, as a low-risk, byte-identical,
first item in the sequencing order (before WPP tuning, residual
SIMD, and the finalize-equality work).

### Can the finalize walk be made provably equal to retained search state before any skip is attempted again?

`open` · `@bpg.question.finalize-equality-before-skip/1`

The prior finalize-skip attempt (BPG_STILLSEARCH_REUSE_RETAINED_FINAL)
failed across Placebo chroma, deblocked luma, and 4:4:4 patterns.
Item 2A of the optimization-testing-plan treats finalize equality
as a correctness-investment prerequisite that must land, and pass,
before item 2B (finalize skip) is attempted again - "item 2B must
not leapfrog 2A".

- `active` [Finalize re-code skip is not shipped; the finalize pass stays load-bearing](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--finalize-re-code-skip-is-not-shipped-the-finalize-pass-stays-load-bearing) `@bpg.decision.finalize-skip-not-shipped/1`

### What residual-pricing SIMD shape works given the serial per-bin context dependency?

`open` · `@bpg.question.residual-pricing-simd-path/1`

The originally-scoped costCoeffNxN-style AVX2 vectorization of
residual pricing does not map onto still265's context-evolving
pricing sink, since sig-flag/C1/C2 costing is a serial dependency
chain through the CABAC-style context models. Item 3 of the
optimization-testing-plan lists context-free residual-pricing SIMD
as an open lever, sequenced after WPP/hybrid tuning and before the
finalize-equality work.

### Why do textured 12 MP images stay slower than bpgenc -m9 after root-TU dedup?

`open` · `@bpg.question.textured-12mp-tail/1`

After the final 1.016x aggregate sweep, two of seven images beat C
outright and the smoothest 50 MP image is effectively at parity,
but the two textured 12 MP images still sit at 1.11x and 1.15x.
Item 6 of the optimization-testing-plan ("textured equal-bytes
quality gap") names this as an open, decision-affecting parallel
track, never blocked by the speed items but re-baselined after any
decision-affecting merge.
